title: Pix2Evidence: A Multimodal RAG System for Text and Visual Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.41335v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over visually rich documents must find both relevant content and the evidence that supports an answer. Screenshot retrieval preserves images and page structure, but written facts within screenshots also need to be searchable. Moreover, topical relevance alone does not identify which retrieved tile contains evidence for the answer. We introduce Pix2Evidence, a multimodal RAG system that encodes each screenshot tile together with its available transcription into a single fused image--text representation, so that layout and readable text are considered jointly during retrieval. To guide evidence selection, a vision-language teacher describes the visible content that supports each training question. We use these descriptions to adapt the retriever, then rerank the retrieved candidates before answer generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Pix2Evidence outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Across

translated_title: Pix2Evidence：一种用于文本与视觉证据的多模态RAG系统
translated_abstract: 针对视觉丰富文档的检索增强生成（RAG）必须同时找到相关内容以及支持答案的证据。截图检索能够保留图像和页面结构，但截图中的文字事实也需要可被搜索。此外，仅凭主题相关性无法确定哪个检索到的图块包含支持答案的证据。我们提出了Pix2Evidence，这是一个多模态RAG系统，它将每个截图图块与其可用的文本转录一起编码为单一的融合图像-文本表示，从而在检索过程中联合考虑布局和可读文本。为了引导证据选择，一个视觉-语言教师模型会描述支持每个训练问题的可见内容。我们利用这些描述来适配检索器，然后在答案生成之前对检索到的候选进行重排序。大量实验表明，Pix2Evidence优于当前最先进的方法。
tldr: Pix2Evidence是一个多模态RAG系统，通过将截图图块与文本转录融合为统一的图像-文本表示实现布局与文本的联合检索，并借助视觉-语言教师模型的描述来适配检索器，从而精准定位支持答案的视觉证据。
en_tdlr: Pix2Evidence is a multimodal RAG system that encodes each screenshot tile with its transcription into a fused image-text representation for joint layout-and-text retrieval, and adapts the retriever using vision-language teacher descriptions to accurately locate evidence supporting the answer.
